# Elegance Makeover & Academy — Complete Technical & Business Knowledge Graph

> Comprehensive documentation of services, pricing, geographic coverage, operational policies, academy curriculum, and founder credentials for Elegance Makeover & Academy (Jajpur Road, Odisha, India).

## 2. Founder Profile: Rasmirekha Swain
- **Role**: Founder, Head Educator, Master Bridal Makeup Artist
- **Industry Experience**: 10+ continuous years in high-definition bridal artistry and beauty therapy
- **Specializations**: Odia bridal transformations, HD brushwork, compressor silicone airbrushing, traditional saree pleating and mukut fitting, facial anatomy contouring

## 3. Exhaustive Service Catalog & Rates

### A. Bridal Makeover Services
1. **Signature Bridal Makeup (HD)**
   - *URL*: https://elegancemakeover.makeup/services/bridal-makeup
   - *Rate*: ₹8,000 – ₹12,000
   - *Session Time*: 3 to 4 hours
   - *Inclusions*: Skin prep and primer barrier, undertone-matched HD base, custom waterproof eye artistry, faux mink 3D lashes, bridal updo/braid with fresh floral and mukut anchoring, traditional Odia saree or lehenga pleating, jewellery pinning, touchup lip pot.
   - *Target Audience*: Traditional Odia brides, reception brides, destination brides.

2. **HD Airbrush Bridal Makeup**
   - *URL*: https://elegancemakeover.makeup/services/hd-airbrush-bridal-makeup
   - *Rate*: ₹12,000 – ₹16,000
   - *Session Time*: 3.5 to 4.5 hours
   - *Inclusions*: Compressor micro-spray silicone base, 4K camera diffusion, 100% waterproof and sweat-resistant formula, high-heat and humidity resilience, multi-dimensional lashes, couture bridal hair styling, dupatta stabilization.
   - *Target Audience*: Outdoor wedding ceremonies, summer/monsoon weddings, brides having 4K cinematic film videography.

3. **Engagement & Reception Makeup**
   - *URL*: https://elegancemakeover.makeup/services/engagement-makeup
   - *Rate*: ₹4,500 – ₹7,000
   - *Session Time*: 2 to 2.5 hours
   - *Inclusions*: Glass-skin radiant base, romantic rose-gold or soft smokey eye artistry, modern textured Hollywood waves or chic updos, gown or pastel lehenga draping.

4. **Party & Occasion Makeup**
   - *URL*: https://elegancemakeover.makeup/services/party-makeup
   - *Rate*: ₹2,500 – ₹4,000
   - *Session Time*: 60 to 90 minutes
   - *Inclusions*: HD skin base, strip eyelashes, color-coordinated eyeshadow, blow-dry or thermal curls, saree pinning. Group discounts available for 3+ members.

### B. Skin & Hair Parlour Services
5. **Hydra Facial (7-in-1 Clinical Infusion)**
   - *URL*: https://elegancemakeover.makeup/services/hydra-facial
   - *Rate*: ₹2,499 – ₹4,999
   - *Session Time*: 60 to 75 minutes
   - *Inclusions*: Ultrasonic peeling, vortex vacuum extraction for blackheads and sebum, botanical AHA/BHA peel, hyaluronic acid and antioxidant peptide infusion, cryo pore-tightening wand, bio-microcurrent lifting, LED phototherapy mask.

6. **Hair Smoothening & Keratin Therapy**
   - *URL*: https://elegancemakeover.makeup/services/hair-smoothening
   - *Rate*: ₹3,999 – ₹7,999
   - *Session Time*: 3 to 5 hours
   - *Inclusions*: Strand elasticity test, clarifying wash, formaldehyde-free L'Oreal or GK Keratin protein treatment, ceramic plate sealing, neutralizer rinse, deep protein mask. Eliminates humidity frizz for 6 to 10 months.

7. **Hair Styling & Precision Cuts**
   - *URL*: https://elegancemakeover.makeup/services/hair-styling
   - *Rate*: ₹300 – ₹2,000
   - *Session Time*: 30 to 75 minutes
   - *Inclusions*: Face-contour cuts, curtain bangs, layer cuts, thermal curls, floral bridal braids, and traditional donut buns with fresh mogra gajra.

### C. Academy Courses & Professional Training
8. **Professional Makeup Academy Course**
   - *URL*: https://elegancemakeover.makeup/services/makeup-academy-course
   - *Rate*: ₹15,000 – ₹35,000
   - *Duration*: 1 Month to 3 Months (Flexible batch timings)
   - *Training Mode*: Onsite practical studio training with 1-on-1 mentorship by Rasmirekha Swain
   - *Curriculum*:
     - Module 1: Skin Physiology, Skin Prep, Color Wheel & Undertones
     - Module 2: HD Foundation Formulations, Brush vs Sponge Stippling, Baking & Contouring
     - Module 3: Eye Artistry (Smokey, Cut-Crease, Haldi Glow, Waterproof Liners, 3D Lashes)
     - Module 4: Airbrush Compressor Assembly, PSI Regulation, Dispersion & Maintenance
     - Module 5: Traditional Odia Bridal Saree Draping, Mukut Fixation, Floral Hair Ornamentation
     - Module 6: Photography, Lighting Setup, Reels Creation, and Client Pricing Psychology
   - *Certification*: Recognized Professional Makeup Artist Diploma awarded upon practical examination.

## 4. Geographic Service Areas & Travel Logistics
Elegance Makeover & Academy provides both in-studio appointments in Jajpur Road and on-location travel throughout Odisha:
- **Jajpur Road** (https://elegancemakeover.makeup/service-areas/jajpur-road): Flagship salon, walk-in and bridal trial base.
- **Vyasanagar** (https://elegancemakeover.makeup/service-areas/vyasanagar): 3 km from studio. Rapid 10-minute dispatch to all local kalyan mandaps.
- **Jajpur Town** (https://elegancemakeover.makeup/service-areas/jajpur-town): 30 km, 45 min transit. Specialized in Biraja Temple sacred weddings.
- **Danagadi** (https://elegancemakeover.makeup/service-areas/danagadi): 12 km, 20 min transit. Fast corridor travel for family banquets.
- **Kalinganagar** (https://elegancemakeover.makeup/service-areas/kalinganagar): 18 km, 25 min transit. On-venue services for corporate township weddings and guest house banquets.
- **Panikoili** (https://elegancemakeover.makeup/service-areas/panikoili): 18 km, 25 min transit via NH16. Punctual early-morning call times.
- **Kuakhia** (https://elegancemakeover.makeup/service-areas/kuakhia): 24 km, 30 min transit. Traditional Odia bridal styling and jewellery placement.
- **Bhadrak** (https://elegancemakeover.makeup/service-areas/bhadrak): 45 km, 50 min transit via NH16. Outstation bridal team bookings.
- **Cuttack** (https://elegancemakeover.makeup/service-areas/cuttack): 75 km, 1.5 hr transit. Heritage venue bridal styling and academy students.
- **Bhubaneswar** (https://elegancemakeover.makeup/service-areas/bhubaneswar): 105 km, 2 hr transit. 5-star hotel destination weddings and advanced masterclasses.

## 5. Travel & Booking Policies
- **On-Location Bridal Bookings**: Minimum booking of 1 bridal makeover or equivalent value. Outstation travel entails roundtrip vehicle transit and lodging if overnight stay is necessary.
- **Deposit & Date Lock**: 20% advance booking deposit required to lock wedding date on the studio calendar.
- **Sanitation Guarantee**: 100% sanitized brush sets, disposable mascara wands, and sterilized tools for every client.
- **In-Studio Trials**: Paid bridal trials available on weekday appointments with prior scheduling.
